details.detail: Door-3 self-service bar (m05, m06, q11). The round-1 trim notes are fixed. The posts are now warm grey-bronze and the counter nosing is bright steel, both matching ANA's render (samchui_11). The layout matches that render: 7 ash doors, the blind, the monitor, the bottle shelf, the glass fridge with its oval latch, and the black soffit edged with lit washi bands. One small miss: the fridge bottles are solid saturated-blue emissive blocks. In the render they are clear bottles with blue labels. Still checked only against the render; no in-service photo exists.

Door-2 welcome galley (m03, m16) vs omaat_ANA-Business-Class-The-Room-32 and lalf_134. The monitor is now the right size (0.86×0.49), the end panels are warm charcoal with portrait monitors that fill the top third, the aluminium nosing wraps the ends, and the dark soffit with downlights sits over the passage. The layout of the control panel, the two ovens, the beverage maker, the cubby and the glass cabinet matches the photo. What remains: the soffit covers only the galley's width (x ±1.10); in lalf_133 and sp_09 it runs out to the door surround.

Door-2 aft monuments (m04, m13, extra renders x1/x2/y4). The centre unit is now the flat ash wall with three aluminium-framed flaps, red latches and low rails, matching lalf_133 well. The 7K galley has ash lower doors, and the 7A closet shares its face with the jump seat. The J backs are cream with wall boxes just under the bins, and curtains hang at both aisle openings. Problem: on the 7K galley, the white galley body shows as a white frame and a strip between the ash doors and the counter (m04). The ash body and the white body are coincident solids, so this is also a z-fighting risk.

Door 1 / F front wall / flight-deck door (q01, m01, m02, x3). The ebony flight-deck door and corridor still match tpa_IMG_0260. The F front curtains were added but stand free: the track is at z 7.50, while the monument faces are at 6.45 (left closet), 6.90 (centre closet) and 6.70 (small galley). Each curtain is therefore a lone column in the middle of the aisle, 0.6 to 1.05 m behind any wall. In ffF_cabin-overview-from-aisle and tpa_IMG_0220, the front wall is continuous right ahead of row 1, with curtains at BOTH edges of each aisle opening. The ink-cloud print is almost invisible: luminance std/mean in the render is 0.054 against 0.13 in TPG 147 and 0.22 in ffF. The step and lit slot over the door-1 galleys are unchanged.

Lavatory exteriors. The J lav door now matches the only in-service view (OMAAT 32): plain ash, a white bi-fold seam strip, a white vertical grab and a white lock slot, with no bronze frame. The F lav is ebony, and the Y/PY and wheelchair lavs are white with a seam, pull and occupancy plate (m09, m11). The proportions are right.

F/J bulkhead, J face (m07) vs tpg_The-Room-small-cabin-front_71. The cream wall, the 1.45 m seam, the blue placards and the wall boxes, now just under the bins at 1.58 / 1.62 m, all match. The curtain is gathered against the outboard panel. It renders #322e2b, 0.31 of the wall's luminance, against 0.45 in the photo (#494548 vs #a59f9a). Slightly too dark in the shadow of the bins.

J/PY bulkhead, PY face (m08). The 2 + 4 tilted grey monitors, the column of 5 staggered pockets up to about 1.1 m, the bassinet mounts and the slate curtains match py_37303, py_37302 and the map. The weak point is the curtain (see the curtains detail).

Door-4 group (m09, m10, q13, y3). The plain PY wall with two grey boxes, the wheelchair lav, the centre and right galleys and the row-30/31 monitors all follow the map and py_37302. The PY aft-end curtains are 0.07 m off the galley at xg -1.22 / 1.24. At 0.2 m wide, each fills the inboard half of the 0.36 m PY walkway (-1.52..-1.16), and m09/m10 read as a navy post in the aisle.

Rear (door 5: m11, m12, q19, y1). The fore-aft galleys, outboard lavs, centre closet and baby lav, and light-grey curtains follow the ANA map (map73E_2). The aft end of the work aisle is still a blank glowing white wall, 1.2 m wide and full height (m12, y1). Near the camera, the rear curtain is a 0.2 m light-grey column with a near-black tie (m11). y_47300 shows untied straight panels with no dark tie.

Standard galley inserts (m01, m12, y1, y3). The latches are now small dark-red turn-buttons, which is better. The ovens, beverage makers with jugs, the carts with cards, the black deck and the work light are all plausible. The upper stowage doors are still blank white slabs with no seam, placard or handle, the biggest single area in every galley shot.

Curtains overall. The colours are now right: F/J and J charcoal-taupe #655e5c against tpg_70 #5d524d, PY slate #40465f against py_37302 #424455, and rear light grey. The J door-2 curtains (m15) match tpg_70: gathered at the outboard wall, tied at mid-height, flared at the hem. Three problems remain. (1) The F front curtains stand free in the aisle (see the door-1 detail). (2) The PY and rear curtains in py_37302 and y_47300 are UNTIED straight pleated panels about 0.40-0.45 m wide, reaching the ceiling. The model uses the same 0.12 m (top) to 0.2 m (hem) tied bundle, which reads as a pole in m08, m09, m10 and m11. (3) The bundles are not flush with the wall edge.

Jump seats. They are now mid-grey on grey pedestals (x5: pad about #9d9d9f, pedestal lighter), the door-2 seat no longer covers the 7A closet door (which is narrowed to 0.38 m), and the door-1 seat clears the F lav door. There are still only 5 seats for 10 Type A doors, and none at doors 3 or 4. The harness straps render blue-grey.

issues.detail: The F front curtains stand free in the aisle, and the F front wall is not continuous
issues.problem: The curtain monuments are at z 7.50, but the monuments ahead of row 1 end at z1 6.45 (left closet -2.70..-1.68), 6.90 (centre closet -0.88..0.28) and 6.70 (galley 0.28..0.82); only the right closet reaches 7.40. Each curtain is a lone 0.2 m column in the middle of the aisle, 0.6-1.05 m behind any wall. It is the dominant object in q01, m02 and x3. There is also one bundle per aisle where the photos show two.
issues.evidence: ffF_cabin-overview-from-aisle.jpg and tpa_IMG_0220.jpg (from row 2 looking forward): a continuous cloud-print front wall directly ahead of row 1, with a curtain at each side of both aisle openings, flush with the wall edges. ANA map (map73E_0): the aft faces of all four door-1 aft monuments lie on one line (y ≈ 520 px), with the curtain dashes along it and row 1 starting 10 px behind. Renders q01 and x3 show the free-standing column with floor visible on both sides.
issues.fix: monoLayoutQA door-1 aft block: bring all F-front monuments to one face at z1 = 7.40, matching the right closet: M('closet', -2.70, -1.68, dz[0][1], 7.40, ...), M('closet', -0.88, 0.28, dz[0][1], 7.40, ...), M('galley', 0.28, 0.82, dz[0][1], 7.40, ...), or keep the galley depth and add an F skin wall at 7.38..7.40. Replace the two curtain lines with four bundles at z 7.43, each flush with an opening edge: M('curtain', -1.68, -0.88, 7.43, 7.43, {xg: -1.68 + 0.11, tone: 'F', h: 0}); M('curtain', -1.68, -0.88, 7.43, 7.43, {xg: -0.88 - 0.11, tone: 'F', h: 0}); M('curtain', 0.82, 1.62, 7.43, 7.43, {xg: 0.82 + 0.11, ...}); M('curtain', 0.82, 1.62, 7.43, 7.43, {xg: 1.62 - 0.11, ...}). Drop the walk rectangle Wk(-1.6, 1.6, 6.90, 7.50), since the aisle rectangles already reach dz[0][1].

issues.detail: PY and rear-economy curtains are the wrong shape: tied poles instead of wide untied panels
issues.problem: Every curtain uses one tied loft: half-width 0.10 × scale, so 0.12 m under the track, 0.09 m at the tie and 0.2 m at the hem, with a dark tie band. The PY (m08, m09, m10) and rear (m11) curtains read as navy or grey posts in the aisle. The PY aft-end ones sit 0.07 m off the galley and fill half of the 0.36 m walkway.
issues.evidence: py_37302: both PY curtains are untied straight pleated panels about 0.40-0.45 m wide (80-160 px beside 0.5 m seat backs at the same depth), hanging from the ceiling to the floor flush against the wall edge. y_47300 shows the same for the light-grey rear curtains, with no tie. By contrast, tpg_70 and tpg_71 (J) show tied bundles, so keep the tie for tones F and C only.
issues.fix: src/10_mono.js curtainLoft: take (levels, n, hx = 0.10, hz = 0.065, lobes = 11) and use hx/hz in place of 0.10/0.065. Build a second geometry _curtainPanel = curtainLoft([[0.02, 1.0], [1.0, 0.97], [CURTAIN_H - 0.01, 0.9]], 60, 0.21, 0.05, 17) with no tie. In addCurtain(B, xa, xb, z, xg, mat, tied), use the panel and skip _curtainTie when mat is curtainY or curtainRear. Place the gather flush: for tones Y/R, xg = edge ± 0.20. In monoLayoutQA: zc4 curtains xg -1.05 - 0.20 = -1.25 → move the track to -1.62..-1.05 and xg -1.25 (flush, since the hem half-width is 0.21). Rear curtains: xg -1.00 - 0.20 and 1.00 + 0.20 against the centre closet/lav (-1..1). For the J/PY partition loop (non-F): xg = right ? a.x1 + 0.20 : b.x0 - 0.20. Keep the tied bundle for F/C, but widen its top level from 0.6 to 0.8 so it does not taper to a stick under the track.

issues.detail: The F ink-cloud print is almost invisible
issues.problem: The inkWall clouds lerp #dcddd8 → #959b90 with t ≤ 0.85 × lowY, where lowY = clamp(1.25 - y/H, 0.25, 1). Above seat height they fade to near nothing. The walls read as plain grey-white (m02, x3).
issues.evidence: Luminance std/mean over the visible wall: render m02 0.054 (mean 207, p5-p95 195-220); TPG 147 0.13 (mean 165, p5-p95 130-195); ffF 0.22. tpa_IMG_0220 shows distinct grey cloud masses from mid-height up to the ceiling.
issues.fix: MONMAT.inkCloud '#959b90' → '#7c8279'. In inkWall: lowY = clamp(1.15 - 0.45 * y / H, 0.55, 1); t = clamp((n - 0.42) / 0.26, 0, 1) ** 1.3 * lowY (drop the 0.85). Target: wall std/mean ≈ 0.12 in m02.

issues.detail: No jump seats at doors 3 and 4 (5 seats for 10 Type A doors)
issues.problem: L.jumps lists doors 1 (×2), 2 (×1) and 5 (×2) only. Certification requires an attendant seat adjacent to each floor-level exit. The cabin looks unstaffed at doors 2R, 3L/R and 4L/R.
issues.evidence: Code: monoLayoutQA L.jumps. No photo shows the door-3 or door-4 seats (see questions).
issues.fix: Stopgap [A] until the user answers: door 3, on the aisle-side (x) walls of the door-3 lavs facing the cross-aisle is impossible (they face forward), so put stowable single seats on the lav faces outboard of the lav doors by narrowing the door-3 lav doors to 0.56 m and shifting them inboard: in buildMon lav, when m.jumpX is set, dx = inner + sign*(dw/2 + 0.03), and add [±2.42, dz[2][1], -1] with jumpX. Door 4: [2.05, dz[3][1], -1] on the door-4 aft centre galley is a counter, so use the right door-4 galley's aisle end instead, or ask. Door 2R: [2.25, dz[1][1], -1] needs the 7K galley's outboard 0.46 m kept free (skip ash door k=last).

issues.detail: Door-2 7K galley: the white body shows through around the ash doors (coincident solids)
issues.problem: buildGalley with m.ashDoors first calls monoStepBody(..., galleyWhite, galleyWhite), whose lower body is 0..dk. It then calls monoBody({...m, h: dk}, barAsh) with identical extents. The two bodies are coincident, so the depth-test winner decides the colour: m04 shows a white frame round the ash door field and a white 0.07 m band under the counter, and z-fighting can flicker at other angles.
issues.evidence: scratchpad/m04_crop.png (crop of r2/m04_d2aft.png, px 280-520 × 370-575): white strip between the aluminium rail and the door tops, and a white right cheek.
issues.fix: buildGalley: monoStepBody(B, m, dk, set, m.ashDoors ? MONMAT.barAsh : body, body) and delete the extra monoBody(B, {...m, h: dk}, MONMAT.barAsh) line. Also raise the ash doors to fill 0.09..0.99 (gRBox(cw/n - 0.01, 0.90, ...) at y 0.54) so the band under the rail is ash.

issues.detail: Door-2 passage soffit stops at the galley width
issues.problem: passageSoffit is called with the welcome galley's x0/x1 (-1.10..1.10). Over the aisles and the lav fronts, out to the doors, the ceiling is white (m16).
issues.evidence: lalf_133 and sp_09: the dark warm soffit with downlights runs the full cross-aisle, from the centre out to the door-surround panel above the L2/R2 door.
issues.fix: In buildMon: if (m.soffitTo !== undefined) passageSoffit(B, -2.15, 2.15, ...). In passageSoffit, add downlights at x ±1.35 and ±1.85 (z ± 0.22). Clip against wallAt(2.13)[0] - 0.05, and check for clashes with the 07b door-area dome; if one clashes, stop at ±1.62, the lav faces.

issues.detail: The aft end wall of the door-5 work aisle is blank
issues.problem: Between the two fore-aft galleys (x -0.63..0.60) at CAB.zAft, the view down the work aisle (m12, y1) ends in a flat, over-bright white wall.
issues.evidence: scratchpad/r2/m12_rearG.png, scratchpad/rb_out/y1_jump5.png. The map (map73E_2) shows the aisle running to the aft bulkhead; the finish is [A].
issues.fix: monoLayoutQA door-5 block: add M('galley', -0.63, 0.60, CAB.zAft - 0.32, CAB.zAft, {face: -1, carts: 0, stowOnly: true, h: 2.15}). In buildGalley, when m.stowOnly is set, skip the carts and the deck, and draw 3 × 4 standard compartment doors (gRBox 0.36 × 0.36, MONMAT.galleyWhite) with copper turn-buttons and card holders, from 0.10 to 1.95 m.

issues.detail: Standard galley upper stowage doors are blank slabs
issues.problem: buildGalley line 416: each upper door is a plain gRBox(uW, 0.36, 0.03) in galleyWhite, the largest area in every galley view (m01, m12, y3).
issues.evidence: sp_09 upper units have visible door seams, recessed paddle latches and small labels.
issues.fix: After line 416: B.add(gRBox(uW - 0.04, 0.32, 0.004, 0.006, 1), F(x, 1.86, o + 0.032), {c: '#c9c6bf', r: 0.45}) as the inset panel; B.add(gQuad(0.07, 0.03), F(x, 1.99, o + 0.031), MONMAT.card) as the label; B.add(gRBox(0.06, 0.018, 0.012, 0.006, 1), F(x, 1.72, o + 0.036), MONMAT.aluDark) as the paddle.

issues.detail: Door-1 forward galleys: depth order and lit slot
issues.problem: The centre galley is z1 4.60 and the right galley 4.78. The map has them the other way round: the centre deeper (to ≈5.0 m) and the right one shallower (≈4.4 m). A bright slot remains above the centre unit (m01).
issues.evidence: map73E_0: centre G to y 411, right G to y 381, door 1 at y 432, about 52 px/m. scratchpad/m01_crop.png shows the white slot.
issues.fix: monoLayoutQA: centre galley z1 4.78, and the right galley d1G.z1 = 4.60, so the faces swap. Add a 0.06 m galleyWhite cap from h to 2.24 over both units.

issues.problem: MONMAT.bottleBlue '#2346c8' with e 0.12 makes six opaque saturated-blue blocks, the most saturated thing in m05 and q11.
issues.evidence: samchui_11: clear glass bottles with blue labels and caps.
issues.fix: Use MONMAT.bottleClear for the fridge bottles with lbl = true, and a label material {c: '#2346c8', r: 0.5} (pass it to bottle() as an optional label mat).

issues.detail: Door-3 monument depth vs the map: no change recommended
issues.problem: Round-1 rater A measured the door-3 lavs at about 1.8 m deep on the map, against 1.05 m in the model.
issues.evidence: The ANA map is not to scale: door 1 → door 2 is 52 px/m but door 3 → door 4 is 64.5 px/m, and the J rows are drawn at about 68 px per row. Map depths are therefore unreliable, and 1.05 m is a standard 777 lav depth. Deepening them would push the J/PY wall and the PY rows into the door-4 galley.

questionsForUser: Where are the flight-attendant jump seats at doors 3 and 4 (and 2R)? Options: on the door-3 lav faces beside the lav doors, on the bar's end cheeks, or on the door-4 galley ends. No photo I found shows them.
Do you have a photo of the new-configuration rear galley at door 5? The aft end wall of the work aisle and the galley finishes follow the map only.
Is there an in-service photo of the door-3 self-service bar? The model still follows only ANA's press render.
